classes.name_en: Assembly of the Republic (Legislative Assembly of the Turkish Federated State of Cyprus, 1976-1983)
classes.finest_note: Party and candidate votes by district from 1976; by ballot box from 2009.
classes.note: Members are elected for five years from open party lists in multi-member districts (the ilçeler), each district's seats set by population before every election (Law 5/1976 art. 52); seats go by d'Hondt to parties over 5% of the national valid vote (art. 133A), and voters may mark candidates across lists. The Federated Assembly had 40 seats (1976, 1981); the Assembly of the Republic has had 50 since 1985. Between the proclamation of 15 November 1983 and the 1985 election the Assembly elected in 1981, enlarged by appointed members, sat as the Constituent Assembly; no election chose it.
